newsitem.title: ITALY: Two children killed by lightning in Italy.
newsitem.headline: Two children killed by lightning in Italy.

text.p: Two children died in northern Italy when the caravan they were sleeping in was struck by lightning and burst into flames, their family said on Sunday.
Seven-year-old Suele Zampagni and her two-year-old sister Lisa were killed after lightning hit the caravan's television antenna causing the TV set to explode.
A nine-year-old boy, who also was asleep in the caravan but away from the TV set, managed to escape before the vehicle was destroyed by fire.
